scene: Kitchen after school. Mom stands at the counter at screen-left with empty hands; Child sits at the table at screen-right with his hands on the tabletop. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child reports his news with bright, proud energy; Mom reacts with warm interest and one soft surprised lift of the eyebrows; both end planning together.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Mom stands at the counter; Child sits at the table with hands on the tabletop.
clips.action: Mom turns toward Child with her question. Child raises one hand like a little reporter while announcing the Friday news; Mom leans in with mild surprise and asks why.
clips.end: Mom rests one hand on the counter; Child sits up straight.

clips.start: Mom rests one hand on the counter; Child sits up straight.
clips.action: Child holds his hands like a small open book while reporting the teachers' meeting. Mom taps her chin thinking about Friday, then raises her eyebrows at the rain-boots news; Child nods clearly.
clips.end: Both look at each other, curious about the boots.

clips.start: Both look at each other, curious about the boots.
clips.action: Mom points down at imaginary boots with both index fingers. Child mimes two small stomping steps in place and sweeps one hand across the table like falling leaves; Mom claps once softly, delighted.
clips.end: Child sits with hands flat on the table, pleased; Mom smiles with empty hands by the counter.
